name: turnstile
description: A tripod turnstile with a full support cabinet, upper housing and three free rotor arms.
useCase: Locate a tripod turnstile at a controlled pedestrian entrance.
misuse: Use ticket-gate for paired fare-gate housings with barrier flaps.

16.reason: The complete cabinet anchors the housing and spindle; all three rotor arms remain free and separated from the support.

24.reason: The wider cabinet counter and independently spaced tripod arms keep the mechanism clear beside the complete upper housing.
